Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary onboarding credit

Hi Brian —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, ClimateAI is planning a 3-month pilot starting June 1 with an expected usage run-rate of ~15k inference-hours/month (mixed chat + embeddings). We want to move quickly to prove value.

Recap of what we discussed:
- Pilot length: 3 months
- Target monthly usage: ~15k inference-hours
- Standard onboarding credit: 1 month of consumption (our policy)
- Customer ask: 30% credit applied across the first three months (effectively ~0.9 months equivalent spread) to reduce friction for procurement and accelerate ramp

I’ve attached the updated proposal (climateai-proposal-v2.pdf) and a cost schedule (pilot-cost-schedule.xlsx). The 30% ask exceeds the standard playbook, so I need to route an internal approval. If possible, can you confirm the following for our internal memo:
1) That ClimateAI will commit to a 3-month pilot and a single point-of-contact for billing
2) That they will sign our standard MPA (I sent a DocuSign draft to their legal)

If we can get an internal exception, I think we win by removing the procurement roadblock and we have a clear expansion path afterward.

Thanks — I’ll loop the internal team to get a quick approval path.

Best,
Mina

mina@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Mina/Aditya —

Appreciate the summary. Quick internal note: Brian has asked for a 30% spread credit over three months which is above our standard one-month onboard credit. For context, this is to accelerate procurement and tie ClimateAI’s platform proof-of-value to usage growth.

Requesting VP/CFO signoff to make a one-time exception. Proposed guardrails for the memo:
- Credit structure: one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of the expected three-month consumption (applied across invoices as a negative line item)
- Condition: signed MPA + Net30 on invoices; credit applied only if invoices paid through the pilot period
- Roll-forward: credit only for pilot period; no downstream rate changes implied by the credit
- Measurement: Redwood to instrument token-level reporting and share weekly usage dashboard with ClimateAI during the pilot

I’ve attached a quick note and asked Aditya to run sensitivity on revenue/protection. If Marcus/Grace approve, we’ll send an executive memo back to Brian with conditions and a DocuSign update.

-Marissa
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Team —

I ran a quick sensitivity based on the numbers in the attached pilot-cost-schedule.xlsx and exported a high-level CSV (financial-analysis.csv). Key points:

- If we grant a 30% credit across the first three months on the stated expected consumption (15k inference-hours/month), the incremental ARR impact (annualized) is small, but there is near-term revenue recognition dilution of ~USD 45k gross across months 1-3.
- A 20% one-time onboarding credit (as Marissa suggested) reduces the near-term dilution to ~USD 30k and preserves a clearer path to full price when the pilot converts.
- Alternative structures to consider: staged rollback (30% month 1, 10% month 2, 0% month 3) or a usage-rebate tied to achieving week-4 usage threshold to avoid over-crediting for no-shows.

Recommendation (fast): Marcus/Grace approve a 20% one-time onboarding credit applied pro rata over the first three invoices with the following conditions:
1) Signed MPA before any credit is applied
2) Invoices remain Net30 and are not past-due during pilot
3) Weekly usage reporting visible to Redwood (dashboard link to be provided)

I attached the CSV analysis. Happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through the numbers.

—Aditya
Sales Operations Analyst | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- financial-analysis.csv (summary rows: credit_scenarios, revenue_impact, conversion_sensitivity)

Team —

Thanks for the analysis and the clear guardrails. I approve a one-time onboarding credit for ClimateAI with the following executive signoff (please include this language in the commercial exception memo and in the DocuSign amendment).

Executive decision (Marcus Lin, VP Finance):
- Approval: One-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of the three-month expected consumption value, to be applied pro rata across the first three invoices of the pilot.
- Conditions:
  * ClimateAI must return a signed MPA prior to the first invoice being issued.
  * All pilot invoices will be Net30; credit will only be applied if invoices are paid on time (no credit applied to unpaid/past-due invoices).
  * Redwood will provision a weekly usage dashboard and provide a single shared contact for billing disputes.
  * Credit does not alter SKU pricing or future renewal bands; it is an acquisition concession only.
- Reporting: Finance will monitor usage and revenue impact; any deviation >15% from expected consumption will trigger a review.

Please prepare a short executive memo (one-pager) for Brian that spells these terms and attach the updated DocuSign MPA. Once I see the DocuSign link and the memo, I’ll countersign the approval artifact.

Marcus Lin
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
